content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The audit right binding us (Article V.IV(b), p0073, with cost allocation at p0064) already sits at the preferred level on two elements — an independent CPA/audit professional selected by mutual agreement, and Licensor-borne cost unless a discrepancy exceeds 5%. But it imposes no frequency cap and no prior notice (the 30-day reference is our deadline to permit the audit, not notice to us), and lacks business-hours, confidentiality, off-site and system-access protections. That is unlimited, unannounced audit exposure, so it fails the fallback and I flagged it as a deviation.

**Cure (two surgical edits, preferred level):** the audit-permission sentence becomes a once-per-12-months, 30-days'-prior-written-notice limit; a new (c) adds business hours, off-site where possible, a confidentiality-bound auditor, and no direct access to our systems. The auditor-selection and 5% cost-shift language is left verbatim and not restated.
